paper.title: Confucius: Iterative Tool Learning from Introspection Feedback by Easy-to-Difficult Curriculum
paper.central_claim: A two-part framework, multi-stage easy-to-difficult fine-tuning plus Iterative Self-instruct from Introspective Feedback (ISIF) that regenerates training data around high-perplexity tool-use instances, makes LLaMA-7B use complicated tools better than tuning-free (ChatGPT, Claude) and tuning-based baselines on seen and unseen toolsets.

signatures.object: Tool-use SFT dataset D (queries plus chain-of-thought tool-call responses) used to fine-tune LLaMA-7B
signatures.information: Model perplexity on its own response given retrieved candidate tools; ChatGPT generates new instances from filtered high-perplexity demonstrations; no tool execution results
signatures.operation: Per epoch: filter high-perplexity instances D*, use them as demonstrations in self-instruct to generate sigma% (best 20%) new instances, append to D, fine-tune next epoch
signatures.output: Grown dataset and updated model weights
signatures.conditions: Seed pool of 110 manual tools; ROUGE-L<0.7 dedup, >=4 tools per instance, heuristic validity filters
signatures.feedback: Perplexity (uncertainty), not outcome or execution feedback
signatures.selection_rule: High-perplexity filter; sigma tuned over {10..30}; no held-out acceptance test of added instances
signatures.persistence: Dataset and weights; tool store unchanged
signatures.claimed_effect: ISIF beats random-instance self-instruct at each dataset size (Fig 3) and removing ISIF lowers all eight Table 4 columns
signatures.failure_boundary: sigma=30% over-fits specific tools and lowers performance

claims.setting: Authors' 110-tool dataset (72,000 instances), Seen and Unseen test sets of 2,000 instances each, LLaMA-7B
claims.baseline_control: Tuning-free LLMs and tuning-based baselines on the same dataset and retrieved candidate tools
claims.selection_vs_test: sigma chosen on unspecified data; Seen toolset reuses training tools by design
claims.result_denominator: 2,000 instances per test set; human evaluation on 50 cases
claims.allowed_conclusion: Author-reported weight-training result; no harness-component conclusion
